questions.question: What is the primary role of the FastAPI application in Vellakshya?
questions.reference_answer: FastAPI acts as the backend server providing document processing, APIs, and real-time collaboration.

questions.question: What coordinate system does PyMuPDF use for extracted text blocks?
questions.reference_answer: PyMuPDF returns bounding box coordinates in unrotated page space.

questions.question: Why is PII redaction performed locally by default?
questions.reference_answer: Local detection prevents uploading unredacted sensitive document text to external cloud providers.

questions.question: What algorithm merges vector distance and keyword search?
questions.reference_answer: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) merges keyword and vector candidate lists.

questions.question: How are citations validated on the server?
questions.reference_answer: The server matches reported chunk IDs against the database index and looks up exact page rectangles.

questions.question: What happens if an LLM returns a chunk ID that was not retrieved?
questions.reference_answer: Any chunk ID not present in the retrieved candidate set is dropped by the server.

questions.question: What vector index type is created in pgvector for chunk embeddings?
questions.reference_answer: An HNSW index with vector_cosine_ops is built on the embedding column.

questions.question: What index is used for PostgreSQL full-text keyword search?
questions.reference_answer: A GIN index on the generated tsvector column.

questions.question: What is the maximum upload size limit configured for Vellakshya?
questions.reference_answer: The upload limit is capped at 30 MiB to remain within HTTP/1 payload thresholds.

questions.question: Why is PyMuPDF executed in a separate process pool?
questions.reference_answer: PyMuPDF is not thread-safe, so multiprocessing is required to prevent event loop crashes.

questions.question: What statutory Indian identifiers are recognized by the PII scanner?
questions.reference_answer: The scanner recognizes Indian PAN, Aadhaar, Passport, Voter ID, and Vehicle Registrations.

questions.question: What is the purpose of doc.scrub() in PyMuPDF?
questions.reference_answer: doc.scrub() removes metadata, XML streams, hidden annotations, and embedded attachments.

questions.question: What parameters are used when saving a scrubbed PDF?
questions.reference_answer: The document is saved with garbage=4 to eliminate unreferenced objects and deflate=True.

questions.question: How are prompt injection attacks mitigated in document retrieval?
questions.reference_answer: Document passages are wrapped in XML tags and treated strictly as untrusted data.

questions.question: What is the default embedding model pinned in configuration?
questions.reference_answer: The default pinned embedding model is text-embedding-004.

questions.question: What fallback providers are supported for text generation?
questions.reference_answer: Google Gemini 1.5 Flash is primary, falling back to OpenAI GPT-4o-mini and local deterministic models.

questions.question: How are cache keys scoped in Redis for question answering?
questions.reference_answer: Keys are partitioned by owner_id, document_id, prompt version, and query hash.

questions.question: What happens if Redis goes offline during operation?
questions.reference_answer: Calls degrade gracefully and bypass the cache without terminating request execution.

questions.question: How does the frontend highlight citations on the PDF canvas?
questions.reference_answer: It applies viewport scaling and rotation transforms to the server-provided rectangle coordinates.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the approval step in PII redaction?
questions.reference_answer: Users review and approve proposed bounding boxes before permanent physical redactions are applied.

questions.question: How is rotation handled when extracting text from a rotated PDF page?
questions.reference_answer: Raw coordinates are multiplied by rotation_matrix to determine visible coordinates.

questions.question: What is the memory limit allocated to Cloud Run in the deployment spec?
questions.reference_answer: Cloud Run is configured with 1 GiB memory and scale-to-zero capability.

questions.question: What happens when a document is deleted under the TTL policy?
questions.reference_answer: Transient memory buffers and database chunk records are cleared.

questions.question: How is decompressed raw byte search performed for redaction testing?
questions.reference_answer: The PDF is saved with expand=255 to uncompress streams, enabling raw byte string searches.

questions.question: Who is the lead architect and author of Vellakshya?
questions.reference_answer: Giri Manohar Vemula is the developer and lead architect.
